title: Desert Landscape Painting
description: A minimalist black and white landscape painting featuring a rugged mountain range in the background and a foreground desert plain dotted with yucca and desert shrubs. The upper portion of the canvas shows thick, textured white brushstrokes representing a bright sky.
prompt: Minimalist black and white desert landscape painting with a rugged mountain range across the horizon and a foreground plain filled with scattered yucca plants and desert shrubs. The sky is rendered with thick expressive white brushstrokes on a white canvas, creating strong contrast between the bold black ink-like forms of the terrain and the textured sky, in a raw expressive style with visible brushwork.
